title: Prospective independent direct-demographic-capacity replication with fixed pollen-background dilution

motivation.source: Independent 40110901–40110964 2x2 K×B experiment completed and exposed
motivation.hypothesis: Reproductive expression-order sensitivity to the postzygotic viable-selfed seed gate is greater under K8 than K48 when pollen background dilution is held at B48

fixed_biological_model.reproduction_equality_at_t0: With matched F8 genotypes, same B48, same visitor and budget, every field of initial reproduction Ledger is identical across K8 versus K48
fixed_biological_model.baseline_B_equal_K_parity: K48_B48 matches canonical unmodified reproduction full Ledger

primary.order_effect: D(K) = average across settings, historical environments, nested demographic repeats, future visitors and original seven log-budget weights of occupancy(A-first)-occupancy(I-first)

bootstrap.paired_by: same visitor history across all K and gates

primary.supported_if: abs(mean)>=0.005 AND entire paired history bootstrap95 excludes zero
primary.practically_equivalent_if: entire paired history bootstrap95 strictly inside [-0.005,+0.005]

secondary_descriptive: By-arm schedule effects under baseline and self_half
Early extinction and recruited offspring totals are survival-dependent and not randomized mediators
integrity_gates: Exact old protocol/model code hash matching before and during all new source production
All 64 complete independent source history shards and 2048 full diploid t400 states including complete parentage
Same exact diploid sampled eight genotype IDs and alleles for both K arms; no survival conditioning
Same B48 at every generation in both K arms; identical initial reproduction Ledger with same gate
Source archive genetic/pedigree verification and SHA-256 per file before future simulation
All 114688 future cells and 64/64 history shards before one readout
Bootstrapping only 64 visitor-history clusters; no retrospective change to success criterion
interpretation_limits: Model-conditional intervention on demographic population capacity at fixed explicit pollen-background denominator; not field island size
Capacity also controls offspring namespace and vacancy competition, which are part of the manipulated demographic mechanism
Assigned transient phenotype expression order is not observed natural genetic emergence order
Previous secondary effect was chosen after outcome exposure; new cohort is required for confirmation
Do not claim genetic mediation, universal ecological rescue, natural island extinction risk or lifetime fitness
